features: 🔋 Solar Powered & Wire-Free Setup – High-efficiency solar panel provides continuous charging, eliminating the need for frequent battery replacement or wiring. Perfect for outdoor security.
🎥 360° PTZ Full Coverage – Pan, Tilt, and Zoom feature allows complete 360-degree monitoring. Control camera direction remotely through mobile app with ease.
🌙 HD Night Vision (Color + IR) – Equipped with LED lights and infrared sensors for clear night vision, ensuring visibility even in complete darkness.
🚨 Smart Motion Detection Alerts – Advanced motion sensors detect movement instantly and send real-time alerts to your phone for quick action.
🎤 Two-Way Audio Communication – Built-in microphone and speaker allow you to talk to visitors or warn intruders in real-time.
📱 Mobile App Remote Access – View live footage, playback recordings, and control camera settings anytime, anywhere directly from your smartphone.
🔧 Easy Installation & Quick Setup – Simple DIY installation with no complicated wiring.
